question: Do saved state assignments have a provenance key that can join them to the raw barcode/QC export?
decision: Permit lineage/doublet and full-background matched null only after a verified cell identity join.
strongest_rival: Equal donor totals or row order can create an unsupported state-to-cell mapping.
discriminator: Inspect actual shared fields and join cardinalities; validate barcode/library uniqueness without assigning states.
exposure_record: Existing source outcomes, scores, clusters and coverage are exposed. This session read saved evidence and metadata before freeze. Newly specified model/qualification outputs have not been run; no blind confirmation is claimed.
biological_unit: Paired donor for biology; individual raw cells for metadata join qualification
nesting_and_overlap: Existing source data are reused; cells/clones/libraries and numerical replicates are not independent mice, patients or donors.
population_and_selection: Immutable v3 saved-state table and corrected human-transfer barcode/QC export.
contrast: Saved state keys versus unique raw barcode/library keys.
endpoint: Shared key columns, many-to-many cardinality and an explicit traceability verdict.
methods: Deterministic key audit; no state attachment by row order, count or score similarity.
missingness_and_exclusions: Apply the exact specification. Retain all failed gates and adverse results; do not infer missing identities, zero cells or unmeasured states.
multiplicity: One bounded package with all declared comparisons retained; exploratory descriptive outputs, no significance or equivalence claims.
precision_basis: No biological effect margin or confirmatory precision is supplied. Numerical checks and finite-sample coverage do not supply biological power.
interpretation_limit: Only the measured qualification or conditional predictive endpoint is supported. No biological mechanism, lineage, functional state, human acceptance or independent replication is established.
stop_rule: Stop on hash, identity, probability or numerical verification failure. Apply package-specific observation/source holds in EXECUTION_SPEC_V1; no outcome-driven retuning.
amendment_reason: Bounded owner-authorized cut-or-fill follow-through; previous results and all exposure retained; exact choices specified prospectively for this new execution.
